Reason for Mistake: In the first step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the initial search results. The search result explicitly stated that Kiliaen van Rensselaer was "born in Hasselt, Overijssel, Netherlands," and included an image caption "Birth house of Kiliaen van Rensselaer in Hasselt, Netherlands." Despite this clear evidence pointing to the Netherlands, the agent incorrectly concluded in its summary that the father was from "Hasselt, Belgium." This initial misinterpretation of the geographic location (confusing Hasselt, Netherlands with Hasselt, Belgium) set off a chain of redundant searches to verify a false premise, leading to the wrong final answer (Belgium instead of the Netherlands).
